The '''1961–62 Copa del Generalísimo''' was the 60th staging of the [[Copa del Rey|Spanish Cup]]. The competition began on 12 November 1961 and ended on 8 July 1962 with the final.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Ferrer |first=Carles Lozano |date=2001-10-20 |title=Spain - Cup 1962 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1962.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260215073339/https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1962.html |archive-date=2026-02-15 |access-date=2026-03-21 |website=[[RSSSF]]}}</ref>
